summary: 硬岩矿选厂实际表现不仅取决于平均资源品位，还取决于不同矿区/矿石类型的配矿与磨矿特性；矿源切换会改变吞吐量、回收率和精矿品位，设计选厂能力不能视为固定。
why_search_may_miss_it: 季度报告往往只给综合品位和产量，矿石硬度、矿物学与配矿变化多在技术报告或运营解释中。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 modeled grade/recovery/strip ratio but not ore-domain variability and blending as a dynamic concentrator constraint
recalled_details.schema_implication: realized mine capacity needs ore_domain/blend/throughput/recovery vintage

suggested_queries: spodumene ore blending hardness concentrator throughput recovery
锂矿 配矿 矿石硬度 选厂 吞吐 回收率
disconfirmation_queries: spodumene concentrator throughput and recovery are invariant to ore-domain changes

summary: 高价阶段部分硬岩项目可能销售DSO、低品位矿石或不同品位精矿，而不是标准SC6；若供给表把矿石吨、低品位产品和6%精矿吨直接相加，会严重高估可比锂单位。
why_search_may_miss_it: 新闻常写‘锂矿发运吨数’，但产品品位和是否经过选矿不一定在标题中，后续统计容易把不同产品视为同一吨。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 distinguished mine milestones but not direct-shipping ore versus concentrate product semantics
recalled_details.schema_implication: hard-rock supply requires product_form, Li2O_grade and dry-equivalent conversion

suggested_queries: lithium DSO direct shipping ore spodumene SC5.5 SC6 shipments
锂矿 DSO 原矿 低品位 精矿 发运
disconfirmation_queries: all reported hard-rock lithium shipment tonnes are SC6-equivalent

summary: 露天矿采剥、钻爆和运输经常依赖承包商、重型矿卡和熟练劳动力；矿业服务价格、设备交付或劳动力短缺会让矿山采矿能力落后于选厂名义能力。
why_search_may_miss_it: 供给数据库关注矿山和选厂，采矿承包商、矿卡和劳动力约束属于更广泛矿服行业，通常不会进入锂供给模型。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 covered roads/ports/power but not mining-services and fleet availability as mine-rate constraints
recalled_details.schema_implication: effective mine capacity should distinguish mining_rate from concentrator_nameplate

suggested_queries: lithium mine contractor fleet shortage ramp mining rate
锂矿 矿服 承包商 矿卡 劳动力 爬坡
disconfirmation_queries: lithium concentrator nameplate always has sufficient mined ore feed

summary: 锂矿包销经常与预付款、债务融资、股权投资或项目建设资金绑定；因此未来精矿流向不仅由股权决定，还可能被早期融资条款锁定，价格下行时这些条款又影响项目生存与重谈判。
why_search_may_miss_it: 包销新闻常只保留买方和数量，融资附带条件、优先权和重谈判机制散落在融资协议中。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 separated equity/offtake/operator roles but not financing-linked offtake as a project-survival and supply-allocation mechanism
recalled_details.schema_implication: offtake edges need financing_link, priority, pricing and validity/revision fields

suggested_queries: lithium mine offtake prepayment project finance spodumene
锂矿 包销 预付款 项目融资 精矿
disconfirmation_queries: hard-rock lithium offtake rights are independent of project financing terms

summary: 锂辉石精矿销售量和报价需要保留Li2O品位、水分和干吨/湿吨基准；SC5.5与SC6的折算、含水率和罚扣会使‘每吨价格’与实际单位锂价值不同。
why_search_may_miss_it: 公开报价经常只写美元/吨，数据库若缺少品位和干湿吨基准，会把合同差异误判成市场价格变化。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 did not make dry/wet tonne and grade adjustment a first-class concentrate pricing semantic
recalled_details.schema_implication: spodumene price facts require Li2O_grade, moisture_basis and dry_wet_mass_basis

suggested_queries: spodumene concentrate price SC6 dry metric tonne moisture adjustment
锂辉石 精矿 SC6 干吨 湿吨 水分 折价
disconfirmation_queries: all spodumene USD/t quotations are directly comparable without grade or moisture basis

summary: 硬岩矿在高价时可能处理低品位矿、历史矿堆或边际矿石，在低价时反向提高cut-off grade、推迟剥采或把矿石留在stockpile；供给弹性不仅来自新项目，还来自现有矿山mine-plan重优化。
why_search_may_miss_it: 宏观供给模型常把在产矿山产能视为固定，cut-off grade和矿堆处理属于矿山工程变量，只有矿山级资料会解释。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 modeled stockpile and mine-plan quality variables separately but not price-driven mine-plan reoptimization as supply elasticity

suggested_queries: lithium mine cutoff grade stockpile processing price mine plan
锂矿 边界品位 低品位 矿堆 价格 采矿计划
disconfirmation_queries: existing hard-rock lithium mine output is price-inelastic until closure
